message.content: In July, Hailey Johnson asked Li Hua to participate in a bread-tasting event at the bakery. Specifically, Hailey planned a bread-tasting event on a Saturday from 10 am to 2 pm and invited Li Hua to assist with gathering feedback from customers. During the event, Li Hua was tasked with chatting with customers and collecting their thoughts on the different breads, potentially noting down some of their favorites. This feedback was crucial for Hailey to understand customer preferences and improve future offerings.
